  <script>
    /* ========== MOBILE MENU ========== */
    const hamburgerBtn = document.getElementById('hamburgerBtn');
    const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
    const mobileOverlay = document.getElementById('mobileOverlay');

    function toggleMobileMenu() {
      const isOpen = mobileNav.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburgerBtn.classList.toggle('active', isOpen);
      hamburgerBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
      mobileOverlay.classList.toggle('visible', isOpen);
      document.body.style.overflow = isOpen ? 'hidden' : '';
    }

    function closeMobileMenu() {
      mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
      hamburgerBtn.classList.remove('active');
      hamburgerBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      mobileOverlay.classList.remove('visible');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    hamburgerBtn.addEventListener('click', toggleMobileMenu);
    mobileOverlay.addEventListener('click', closeMobileMenu);

    mobileNav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function(link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', closeMobileMenu);
    });

    /* ========== DONATION MODAL ========== */
    const donateModal = document.getElementById('donateModal');
    const modalCloseBtn = document.getElementById('modalCloseBtn');
    const modalDonateBtn = document.getElementById('modalDonateBtn');
    const customAmountInput = document.getElementById('customAmount');
    const modalImpact = document.getElementById('modalImpact');
    let selectedAmount = null;

    const impactMap = {
      25: 'Provides 5 emergency blankets for displaced families',
      50: 'Supplies a family with food and water for one week',
      100: 'Funds emergency shelter materials for a household',
      250: 'Equips a volunteer with disaster response training',
      500: 'Provides medical supplies for a field clinic',
      1000: 'Funds a complete emergency response kit for a family'
    };

    function openDonateModal(presetAmount) {
      donateModal.classList.add('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      selectedAmount = presetAmount || null;

      document.querySelectorAll('.modal-amount-btn').forEach(function(btn) {
        var amt = parseInt(btn.dataset.amount);
        btn.classList.toggle('selected', amt === selectedAmount);
      });

      if (selectedAmount && impactMap[selectedAmount]) {
        modalImpact.innerHTML = '<strong>$' + selectedAmount + '</strong> — ' + impactMap[selectedAmount];
      } else {
        modalImpact.innerHTML = '<strong>Every dollar counts</strong> toward saving lives. 91% of your donation goes directly to humanitarian services.';
      }

      if (!presetAmount) customAmountInput.focus();
    }

    function closeDonateModal() {
      donateModal.classList.remove('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    document.getElementById('heroDonateBtn').addEventListener('click', function() { openDonateModal(null); });
    document.getElementById('navDonateBtn').addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); openDonateModal(null); });
    document.getElementById('mobileDonateBtn').addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); closeMobileMenu(); openDonateModal(null); });
    document.getElementById('ctaDonateBtn').addEventListener('click', function() { openDonateModal(selectedAmount); });
    document.getElementById('footerDonateLink').addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); openDonateModal(null); });
    modalCloseBtn.addEventListener('click', closeDonateModal);
    donateModal.addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (e.target === donateModal) closeDonateModal(); });

    document.querySelectorAll('.modal-amount-btn').forEach(function(btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        selectedAmount = parseInt(this.dataset.amount);
        customAmountInput.value = '';
        document.querySelectorAll('.modal-amount-btn').forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove('selected'); });
        this.classList.add('selected');
        if (impactMap[selectedAmount]) {
          modalImpact.innerHTML = '<strong>$' + selectedAmount + '</strong> — ' + impactMap[selectedAmount];
        }
      });
    });

    customAmountInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
      var val = parseInt(this.value);
      if (val > 0) {
        selectedAmount = val;
        document.querySelectorAll('.modal-amount-btn').forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove('selected'); });
        modalImpact.innerHTML = '<strong>$' + val + '</strong> — Every dollar counts toward saving lives.';
      }
    });

    /* ========== DONATE AMOUNTS SECTION ========== */
    document.querySelectorAll('.donate-amount').forEach(function(item) {
      item.addEventListener('click', function() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.donate-amount').forEach(function(i) { i.classList.remove('selected'); });
        this.classList.add('selected');
        selectedAmount = parseInt(this.dataset.amount);
      });
    });

    /* ========== ACCORDION ========== */
    document.querySelectorAll('.accordion-header').forEach(function(header) {
      header.addEventListener('click', function() {
        var item = this.parentElement;
        var body = item.querySelector('.accordion-body');
        var inner = body.querySelector('.accordion-body-inner');
        var isActive = item.classList.contains('active');

        document.querySelectorAll('.accordion-item').forEach(function(ai) {
          ai.classList.remove('active');
          ai.querySelector('.accordion-header').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          ai.querySelector('.accordion-body').style.maxHeight = '0';
        });

        if (!isActive) {
          item.classList.add('active');
          this.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
          body.style.maxHeight = inner.scrollHeight + 32 + 'px';
        }
      });
    });

    /* ========== NEWS CAROUSEL ========== */
    var carouselTrack = document.getElementById('carouselTrack');
    var carouselPrev = document.getElementById('carouselPrev');
    var carouselNext = document.getElementById('carouselNext');
    var carouselIndex = 0;

    function getCardsPerView() {
      if (window.innerWidth <= 768) return 1;
      return 2;
    }

    function getTotalCards() {
      return carouselTrack.querySelectorAll('.news-card').length;
    }

    function updateCarousel() {
      var cardsPerView = getCardsPerView();
      var totalCards = getTotalCards();
      var maxIndex = Math.max(0, totalCards - cardsPerView);
      carouselIndex = Math.min(carouselIndex, maxIndex);
      carouselIndex = Math.max(0, carouselIndex);

      var card = carouselTrack.querySelector('.news-card');
      var gap = 24;
      var cardWidth = card.offsetWidth;
      var offset = carouselIndex * (cardWidth + gap);
      carouselTrack.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + offset + 'px)';
    }

    carouselNext.addEventListener('click', function() {
      var cardsPerView = getCardsPerView();
      var maxIndex = Math.max(0, getTotalCards() - cardsPerView);
      if (carouselIndex < maxIndex) {
        carouselIndex++;
        updateCarousel();
      }
    });

    carouselPrev.addEventListener('click', function() {
      if (carouselIndex > 0) {
        carouselIndex--;
        updateCarousel();
      }
    });

    window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
      carouselIndex = 0;
      updateCarousel();
    });

    /* ========== ANIMATED COUNTERS ========== */
    var counters = document.querySelectorAll('.counter');
    var counterAnimated = false;

    function animateCounters() {
      if (counterAnimated) return;
      counterAnimated = true;

      counters.forEach(function(counter) {
        var target = parseInt(counter.dataset.target);
        var duration = 2000;
        var start = 0;
        var startTime = null;

        function step(timestamp) {
          if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
          var progress = Math.min((timestamp - startTime) / duration, 1);
          var eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
          counter.textContent = Math.floor(eased * target);
          if (progress < 1) {
            requestAnimationFrame(step);
          } else {
            counter.textContent = target;
          }
        }

        requestAnimationFrame(step);
      });
    }

    var impactObserver = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
      entries.forEach(function(entry) {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          animateCounters();
          impactObserver.disconnect();
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.3 });

    impactObserver.observe(document.getElementById('impact'));

    /* ========== KEYBOARD: ESC CLOSES MODAL ========== */
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if (donateModal.classList.contains('open')) closeDonateModal();
        if (mobileNav.classList.contains('open')) closeMobileMenu();
      }
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

    /* ========== PROGRAMS ========== */

    /* ========== GET INVOLVED ========== */

    .involved-card {

    .involved-icon {

      align-items: center;

    .involved-icon svg {

      height: 28px;
      stroke: var(--red);

    .involved-card h3 {
      font-size: 1.25rem;
      color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .involved-card p {
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
    }

    .btn-outline {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      padding: 10px 24px;
      font-size: 0.9375rem;

      color: var(--red);

      transition: all var(--transition);

    .btn-outline:hover {
      background: var(--red);

    /* ========== NEWS ========== */
    .news {
      padding: 80px 0;
      background: var(--gray-50);
    }

    .news-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      margin-bottom: 40px;
    }

    .news-header h2 {
      font-family: var(--font-serif);
      font-size: 2rem;
      color: var(--navy);
    }

    .carousel-controls {
      display: flex;
      gap: 8px;

    .carousel-btn {
      width: 44px;
      height: 44px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-300);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: all var(--transition);
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .carousel-btn:hover {
      border-color: var(--navy);
      background: var(--navy);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .carousel-btn:hover svg { stroke: var(--white); }

    .carousel-btn svg {
      width: 20px;
      height: 20px;
      stroke: var(--gray-600);
    }

    .carousel-viewport {
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .carousel-track {
      display: flex;
      gap: 24px;
      transition: transform 0.4s ease;
    }

    .news-card {
      flex: 0 0 calc(50% - 12px);
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 12px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid var(--gray-200);
      transition: transform var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition);

    .news-card:hover {
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    .news-card-image {
      width: 100%;
      height: 200px;
      background: var(--gray-200);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--gray-400);
      font-size: 0.875rem;
    }

    .news-card-body {
      padding: 24px;
    }

    .news-card-tag {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      color: var(--red);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
    }

    .news-card-body h3 {
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      color: var(--navy);
      margin-bottom: 8px;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .news-card-body p {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      line-height: 1.6;
    }

    /* ========== DONATE CTA ========== */
    .donate-cta {
      padding: 80px 0;
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .donate-cta-inner {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--red) 0%, var(--red-dark) 100%);
      border-radius: 20px;
      padding: 64px;
      color: var(--white);
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 48px;
      align-items: center;
    }

    .donate-cta-text h2 {
      font-family: var(--font-serif);
      font-size: 2.25rem;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .donate-cta-text p {
      font-size: 1.0625rem;
      opacity: 0.9;
      line-height: 1.7;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
    }

    .donate-cta-text .efficiency {
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      opacity: 0.85;
    }

    .donate-amounts {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .donate-amount {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 16px;
      padding: 16px 20px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.12);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background var(--transition);
    }

    .donate-amount:hover {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2);
    }

    .donate-amount.selected {
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.25);
      border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.5);
    }

    .donate-amount-value {
      font-size: 1.375rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      min-width: 72px;
    }

    .donate-amount-impact {
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      opacity: 0.85;
    }

    .btn-donate-large {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      padding: 16px;
      background: var(--white);
      color: var(--red);
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      text-align: center;
      margin-top: 16px;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .btn-donate-large:hover {
      background: var(--gray-100);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
    }

    /* ========== DONATION MODAL ========== */
    .modal-overlay {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
      z-index: 200;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 24px;
    }

    .modal-overlay.open {
      display: flex;
    }

    .modal {
      background: var(--white);
      border-radius: 16px;
      max-width: 520px;
      width: 100%;
      max-height: 90vh;
      overflow-y: auto;
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-xl);
      animation: modalIn 0.3s ease;
    }

    @keyframes modalIn {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.95) translateY(10px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1) translateY(0); }
    }

    .modal-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 24px 24px 0;
    }

    .modal-header h2 {
      font-family: var(--font-serif);
      font-size: 1.5rem;
      color: var(--navy);
    }

    .modal-close {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: var(--gray-500);
      transition: background var(--transition);
    }

    .modal-close:hover { background: var(--gray-100); }

    .modal-body {
      padding: 24px;
    }

    .modal-amounts {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 12px;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .modal-amount-btn {
      padding: 16px 8px;
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: var(--gray-700);
      transition: all var(--transition);
      background: var(--white);
    }

    .modal-amount-btn:hover {
      border-color: var(--red);
      color: var(--red);
    }

    .modal-amount-btn.selected {
      background: var(--red);
      border-color: var(--red);
      color: var(--white);
    }

    .modal-custom {
      margin-bottom: 20px;
    }

    .modal-custom input {
      width: 100%;
      padding: 14px 16px;
      border: 2px solid var(--gray-200);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      font-size: 1rem;
      font-family: var(--font-sans);
      transition: border-color var(--transition);
    }

    .modal-custom input:focus {
      outline: none;
      border-color: var(--red);
    }

    .modal-custom input::placeholder {
      color: var(--gray-400);
    }

    .modal-impact {
      background: var(--gray-50);
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      padding: 16px;
      margin-bottom: 24px;
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      color: var(--gray-600);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .modal-impact strong {
      color: var(--navy);
    }

    .btn-modal-donate {
      display: block;
      width: 100%;
      padding: 16px;
      background: var(--red);
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 1.125rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      text-align: center;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .btn-modal-donate:hover {
      background: var(--red-dark);
    }

    .modal-secure {
      text-align: center;
      margin-top: 12px;
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      color: var(--gray-400);
    }

    /* ========== FOOTER ========== */
    .footer {
      background: var(--gray-900);
      color: var(--gray-300);
      padding: 64px 0 32px;
    }

    .footer-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: 40px;
      margin-bottom: 48px;
    }

    .footer-col h4 {
      color: var(--white);
      font-size: 0.9375rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
    }

    .footer-col a {
      display: block;
      font-size: 0.875rem;
      padding: 4px 0;
      opacity: 0.7;
      transition: opacity var(--transition);
    }

    .footer-col a:hover { opacity: 1; }

    .footer-bottom {
      border-top: 1px solid var(--gray-700);
      padding-top: 24px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .footer-copy {
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      opacity: 0.6;
    }

    .footer-social {
      display: flex;
      gap: 16px;
    }

    .footer-social a {
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--gray-800);
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      opacity: 0.7;
      transition: all var(--transition);
    }

    .footer-social a:hover {
      opacity: 1;
      background: var(--red);
    }

    .footer-social svg {
      width: 18px;
      height: 18px;
      fill: var(--gray-300);
    }

    /* ========== RESPONSIVE ========== */
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .hero .container {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 40px;
      }
      .hero-text h1 { font-size: 2.5rem; }
      .hero-image { display: none; }
      .impact .container { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .involved-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .donate-cta-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }

    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .nav-desktop { display: none; }
      .hamburger { display: flex; }
      .mobile-nav { display: block; }
      .mobile-overlay { display: block; pointer-events: none; }
      .mobile-overlay.visible { pointer-events: auto; }
      .header-top { display: none; }
      .hero { padding: 48px 0; }
      .hero-text h1 { font-size: 2rem; }
      .stat-number { font-size: 2.25rem; }
      .involved-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .news-card { flex: 0 0 100%; }
      .donate-cta-inner { padding: 36px 24px; }
      .donate-cta-text h2 { font-size: 1.75rem; }
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
      .modal-amounts { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .hero-text h1 { font-size: 1.75rem; }
      .impact .container { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 24px; }
      .footer-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    }
  </style>
</head>

  </nav>

  <!-- ========== HERO ========== -->
  <section class="hero" id="hero">
    <div class="container">
      <div class="hero-text">
        <h1>When Disaster Strikes, We're There</h1>
        <p>From hurricanes and wildfires to global health emergencies, Global Aid Alliance delivers immediate relief and long-term recovery support to communities in crisis.</p>
        <div class="hero-actions">
          <button class="btn btn-primary" id="heroDonateBtn">Donate Now</button>

        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="hero-image">

          <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">
            <path stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" d="M12 21a9.004 9.004 0 008.716-6.747M12 21a9.004 9.004 0 01-8.716-6.747M12 21c2.485 0 4.5-4.03 4.5-9S14.485 3 12 3m0 18c-2.485 0-4.5-4.03-4.5-9S9.515 3 12 3m0 0a8.997 8.997 0 017.843 4.582M12 3a8.997 8.997 0 00-7.843 4.582m15.686 0A11.953 11.953 0 0112 10.5c-2.998 0-5.74-1.1-7.843-2.918m15.686 0A8.959 8.959 0 0121 12c0 .778-.099 1.533-.284 2.253m0 0A17.919 17.919 0 0112 16.5c-3.162 0-6.133-.815-8.716-2.247m0 0A9.015 9.015 0 013 12c0-1.605.42-3.113 1.157-4.418"/>

  <!-- ========== MISSION ========== -->
  <section class="mission" id="mission">
    <div class="container">
      <span class="section-label">Our Mission</span>
      <h2>Global Aid Alliance prevents and alleviates human suffering in the face of emergencies by mobilizing the power of volunteers and the generosity of donors.</h2>
      <p>We are guided by the fundamental principles of humanity, impartiality, and neutrality. Every day, our teams work across borders and boundaries to ensure that help reaches those who need it most — regardless of race, religion, nationality, or political affiliation. From the first hours of a disaster to the years of recovery that follow, we stand with affected communities every step of the way.</p>

  <script>
    /* ========== MOBILE MENU ========== */
    const hamburgerBtn = document.getElementById('hamburgerBtn');
    const mobileNav = document.getElementById('mobileNav');
    const mobileOverlay = document.getElementById('mobileOverlay');

    function toggleMobileMenu() {
      const isOpen = mobileNav.classList.toggle('open');
      hamburgerBtn.classList.toggle('active', isOpen);
      hamburgerBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen);
      mobileOverlay.classList.toggle('visible', isOpen);
      document.body.style.overflow = isOpen ? 'hidden' : '';
    }

    function closeMobileMenu() {
      mobileNav.classList.remove('open');
      hamburgerBtn.classList.remove('active');
      hamburgerBtn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      mobileOverlay.classList.remove('visible');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    hamburgerBtn.addEventListener('click', toggleMobileMenu);
    mobileOverlay.addEventListener('click', closeMobileMenu);

    mobileNav.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function(link) {
      link.addEventListener('click', closeMobileMenu);
    });

    /* ========== DONATION MODAL ========== */
    const donateModal = document.getElementById('donateModal');
    const modalCloseBtn = document.getElementById('modalCloseBtn');
    const modalDonateBtn = document.getElementById('modalDonateBtn');
    const customAmountInput = document.getElementById('customAmount');
    const modalImpact = document.getElementById('modalImpact');
    let selectedAmount = null;

    const impactMap = {
      25: 'Provides 5 emergency blankets for displaced families',
      50: 'Supplies a family with food and water for one week',
      100: 'Funds emergency shelter materials for a household',
      250: 'Equips a volunteer with disaster response training',
      500: 'Provides medical supplies for a field clinic',
      1000: 'Funds a complete emergency response kit for a family'
    };

    function openDonateModal(presetAmount) {
      donateModal.classList.add('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
      selectedAmount = presetAmount || null;

      document.querySelectorAll('.modal-amount-btn').forEach(function(btn) {
        var amt = parseInt(btn.dataset.amount);
        btn.classList.toggle('selected', amt === selectedAmount);
      });

      if (selectedAmount && impactMap[selectedAmount]) {
        modalImpact.innerHTML = '<strong>$' + selectedAmount + '</strong> — ' + impactMap[selectedAmount];
      } else {
        modalImpact.innerHTML = '<strong>Every dollar counts</strong> toward saving lives. 91% of your donation goes directly to humanitarian services.';
      }

      if (!presetAmount) customAmountInput.focus();
    }

    function closeDonateModal() {
      donateModal.classList.remove('open');
      document.body.style.overflow = '';
    }

    document.getElementById('heroDonateBtn').addEventListener('click', function() { openDonateModal(null); });
    document.getElementById('navDonateBtn').addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); openDonateModal(null); });
    document.getElementById('mobileDonateBtn').addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); closeMobileMenu(); openDonateModal(null); });
    document.getElementById('ctaDonateBtn').addEventListener('click', function() { openDonateModal(selectedAmount); });
    document.getElementById('footerDonateLink').addEventListener('click', function(e) { e.preventDefault(); openDonateModal(null); });
    modalCloseBtn.addEventListener('click', closeDonateModal);
    donateModal.addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (e.target === donateModal) closeDonateModal(); });

    document.querySelectorAll('.modal-amount-btn').forEach(function(btn) {
      btn.addEventListener('click', function() {
        selectedAmount = parseInt(this.dataset.amount);
        customAmountInput.value = '';
        document.querySelectorAll('.modal-amount-btn').forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove('selected'); });
        this.classList.add('selected');
        if (impactMap[selectedAmount]) {
          modalImpact.innerHTML = '<strong>$' + selectedAmount + '</strong> — ' + impactMap[selectedAmount];
        }
      });
    });

    customAmountInput.addEventListener('input', function() {
      var val = parseInt(this.value);
      if (val > 0) {
        selectedAmount = val;
        document.querySelectorAll('.modal-amount-btn').forEach(function(b) { b.classList.remove('selected'); });
        modalImpact.innerHTML = '<strong>$' + val + '</strong> — Every dollar counts toward saving lives.';
      }
    });

    /* ========== DONATE AMOUNTS SECTION ========== */
    document.querySelectorAll('.donate-amount').forEach(function(item) {
      item.addEventListener('click', function() {
        document.querySelectorAll('.donate-amount').forEach(function(i) { i.classList.remove('selected'); });
        this.classList.add('selected');
        selectedAmount = parseInt(this.dataset.amount);
      });
    });

    /* ========== ACCORDION ========== */
    document.querySelectorAll('.accordion-header').forEach(function(header) {
      header.addEventListener('click', function() {
        var item = this.parentElement;
        var body = item.querySelector('.accordion-body');
        var inner = body.querySelector('.accordion-body-inner');
        var isActive = item.classList.contains('active');

        document.querySelectorAll('.accordion-item').forEach(function(ai) {
          ai.classList.remove('active');
          ai.querySelector('.accordion-header').setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
          ai.querySelector('.accordion-body').style.maxHeight = '0';
        });

        if (!isActive) {
          item.classList.add('active');
          this.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
          body.style.maxHeight = inner.scrollHeight + 32 + 'px';
        }
      });
    });

    /* ========== NEWS CAROUSEL ========== */
    var carouselTrack = document.getElementById('carouselTrack');
    var carouselPrev = document.getElementById('carouselPrev');
    var carouselNext = document.getElementById('carouselNext');
    var carouselIndex = 0;

    function getCardsPerView() {
      if (window.innerWidth <= 768) return 1;
      return 2;
    }

    function getTotalCards() {
      return carouselTrack.querySelectorAll('.news-card').length;
    }

    function updateCarousel() {
      var cardsPerView = getCardsPerView();
      var totalCards = getTotalCards();
      var maxIndex = Math.max(0, totalCards - cardsPerView);
      carouselIndex = Math.min(carouselIndex, maxIndex);
      carouselIndex = Math.max(0, carouselIndex);

      var card = carouselTrack.querySelector('.news-card');
      var gap = 24;
      var cardWidth = card.offsetWidth;
      var offset = carouselIndex * (cardWidth + gap);
      carouselTrack.style.transform = 'translateX(-' + offset + 'px)';
    }

    carouselNext.addEventListener('click', function() {
      var cardsPerView = getCardsPerView();
      var maxIndex = Math.max(0, getTotalCards() - cardsPerView);
      if (carouselIndex < maxIndex) {
        carouselIndex++;
        updateCarousel();
      }
    });

    carouselPrev.addEventListener('click', function() {
      if (carouselIndex > 0) {
        carouselIndex--;
        updateCarousel();
      }
    });

    window.addEventListener('resize', function() {
      carouselIndex = 0;
      updateCarousel();
    });

    /* ========== ANIMATED COUNTERS ========== */
    var counters = document.querySelectorAll('.counter');
    var counterAnimated = false;

    function animateCounters() {
      if (counterAnimated) return;
      counterAnimated = true;

      counters.forEach(function(counter) {
        var target = parseInt(counter.dataset.target);
        var duration = 2000;
        var start = 0;
        var startTime = null;

        function step(timestamp) {
          if (!startTime) startTime = timestamp;
          var progress = Math.min((timestamp - startTime) / duration, 1);
          var eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 3);
          counter.textContent = Math.floor(eased * target);
          if (progress < 1) {
            requestAnimationFrame(step);
          } else {
            counter.textContent = target;
          }
        }

        requestAnimationFrame(step);
      });
    }

    var impactObserver = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
      entries.forEach(function(entry) {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          animateCounters();
          impactObserver.disconnect();
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.3 });

    impactObserver.observe(document.getElementById('impact'));

    /* ========== KEYBOARD: ESC CLOSES MODAL ========== */
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') {
        if (donateModal.classList.contains('open')) closeDonateModal();
        if (mobileNav.classList.contains('open')) closeMobileMenu();
      }
    });
  </script>
</body>
</html>

All files are complete. Here's a summary of what was built:

**`/app/output/index.html`** — Single-page corporate website with all 9 required sections:

| Section | Key Features |
|---------|-------------|
| **Header** | Sticky nav, mobile hamburger menu with slide-out drawer + overlay |
| **Hero** | "When Disaster Strikes, We're There" + Donate Now button (opens modal) + Become a Volunteer |
| **Mission** | Centered mission statement with serif heading |
| **Impact Stats** | 4 animated counters (12M, 50K, 190, $850M) triggered by IntersectionObserver |
| **Programs** | 5-item accordion (Disaster Relief, Blood Donation, Emergency Preparedness, International Aid, Community Health) |
| **Get Involved** | 3 cards with icons and CTAs (Volunteer, Fundraiser, Give Blood) |
| **News** | 4-card carousel with functional prev/next navigation |
| **Donate CTA** | Amount selection panel with impact descriptions + Donate Now button |
| **Footer** | 4-column nav, social icons, copyright + tax ID |

**Interactions implemented:**
- **Donation modal** — triggered from hero, header nav, mobile nav, CTA section, and footer; includes preset amounts ($25–$1000), custom input, and dynamic impact text
- **Mobile menu** — hamburger toggle with overlay, closes on link click or ESC
- **News carousel** — next/prev buttons, responsive (2 cards desktop, 1 mobile)
- **Program accordion** — single-open expand/collapse with smooth animation

**SEO package:**
- Full `<head>` with title, meta description, Open Graph, Twitter Cards, geo tags
- JSON-LD `NGO` schema + `FAQPage` schema
- `robots.txt` with sitemap reference
- `sitemap.xml` with homepage entry

**Design:** Deep red (#C41E3A) + navy (#1B3A5C) palette, Inter + Merriweather fonts, fully responsive from mobile to desktop.
